authority.note: Sealed BEFORE any y_R_gross was computed. Historical F-xxx (including F-086) are not economic closure of THIS object. F-086 remains the definitive answer on the declared M15 vocabulary marking a profitable entry bar and is not reopened. Identity 4-of-4 L5 rows are CRTEngine closes, a different object. economic_claims_allowed stays false until mt00==PASS and mt01_matrix_coverage==COMPLETE (repo-wide 0/27 probes). A positive diagnostic expectancy is NOT economic validation and grants no G001.

population.inclusion_rule: MEASUREMENT CORPUS = data/mt5/XAUUSD_M15.csv ONLY (47275 bars, sha256 4d73f5cebe33ec91c5312340337eb62c2cf1f49060c91c42761bf631b26aba56). One unit = one SEM-026 inside-close entry after a big calendar mother (x=16), fade to opposite extreme, one open at a time. SUCCESS GATE uses HOLDOUT units only (entry_ts >= 2025-12-24 19:15:00, corpus index 37820).
population.exclusion_rule: F-086 236-bar stride holdout is NOT this split and remains unspent. Identity L5 engine closes are not units. CRT TRADE_OPENED is not a unit. opportunities.jsonl is not a unit. Positional (non-calendar) blocks are not this object.

features.point_in_time_rule: Decision t = C2, the last close of calendar test block i+1. Mother high/low and big-mother threshold use only blocks at or before mother i. No future bars. F-051 centered-swing is OUT OF PATH. F-066 session labels are OUT OF PATH.

InsideScore.formula_ref: (C2 - L1) / (H1 - L1) on calendar mother/test pair

forbidden_aliases: identity L5 engine_trade as this population

labels.y_definition: y_R_gross = forward_walk.intrabar_fixed R-multiple of SEM-026 entry with SL/TP at mother extremes. y_R_net = SEM-015 ComponentCostModel net of that gross. Never opportunities.outcome (F-022).
labels.sign_convention: LONG positive when price rises; SHORT positive when price falls; R = pnl / initial_risk

components.name: gross_basis
components.bps_or_formula: none_gross is NAMED for the walk identity. Net diagnostic uses SEM-015 measured half_spread 0.045 + commission 0.040 per leg, entry_slippage 0.090 (PROXY_FROM_STOP), stop_slippage 0.090 on SL only.

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars between last train entry horizon and first test entry
splits.purge: drop train units whose 40-bar horizon overlaps test start
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: last 20% of corpus bars by index; first holdout bar 2025-12-24 19:15:00 (idx 37820). F-086 stride holdout of 236 bars is a different split and is not spent.

metrics.success_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Holdout n>=30 AND net_expectancy_R>0 AND profit_factor>1 AND beats long_only (same entries, direction forced long, same risk distance). Meeting every clause is NOT economic validation while economic_claims_allowed is false.
metrics.kill_criteria: Any outcome including n=0 or n<30 is registered. Changing block size, calendar vs positional, atr_mult, lookback, fade rule, SL/TP, walk, cost, fill, or split after seeing y requires a NEW MC-* id. Do not harvest 100% positive windows.

pipeline_identity.config_version_source: NOT the production config path. Thresholds frozen in docs/research/mother_range_trade_object.md. ACTIVE_VERSION is never written.

prohibited_substitutions.forbidden: Count identity L5 engine closes or CRT TRADE_OPENED as mother-range units
Substitute trailing or stream outcome for forward_walk.intrabar_fixed
Spend F-086's 236-bar stride holdout as this experiment's test set, or report train expectancy as the success gate
Harvest 100% positive time windows after seeing y, or present diagnostic expectancy as economic validation
Use positional blocks or SEM-011 as the mother range

open_risks_non_blocking: Holdout n may be <30 (INSUFFICIENT, not harmful)
F-086 stride holdout remains unspent by design
